name: beach_walk_side_profile
description: A beach side-profile walking pose capturing a relaxed stride along the shoreline. Perfect for lifestyle and travel photography with natural ocean backdrop.
tips: Walk naturally as if strolling along the beach
Keep your gaze toward the horizon, not the camera
Let your arms swing gently with the stride
Position the ocean or shoreline in the background
Shoot during golden hour for warm, flattering light
Use a slightly slower shutter for motion blur in the waves
Ensure even weight distribution for a relaxed look
Frame subject on the left/right third for composition
